heading.en: Early life and Red Army political work

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，譚政1906年6月14日生於湖南湘鄉。1927年3月前往武漢加入國民革命軍第四方面軍，9月隨警衛團參加湘贛邊界秋收起義，10月加入中國共產黨。1928年2月任中共前敵委員會秘書，在毛澤東身邊工作；1929年起歷任團黨委秘書、紅4軍軍委秘書長、紅4軍政治部訓練部部長，並協助毛澤東起草《古田會議決議》。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Tan Zheng was born on 14 June 1906 in Xiangxiang, Hunan. In March 1927 he went to Wuhan and joined the Fourth Front Army of the National Revolutionary Army, took part in the Autumn Harvest Uprising with a guard regiment in September, and joined the Communist Party in October. In February 1928 he became secretary of the Front Committee, working beside Mao Zedong; from 1929 he served as regimental party-committee secretary, secretary-general of the 4th Red Army military committee and head of the training section of its political department, and helped Mao draft the Gutian Conference resolution.

heading.zh-Hant: 長征至抗戰時期的政治工作
heading.en: Long March and the war of resistance

body.zh-Hant: 1934年10月長征開始後，譚政任紅1師政治委員、紅1軍團政治部組織部部長。1936年6月入紅軍大學學習，畢業後任紅軍後方政治部組織部部長、政治部主任。抗日戰爭爆發後任中央軍委總政治部副主任兼八路軍後方政治部主任；1943年調任陝甘寧晉綏聯防軍副政治委員兼政治部主任，1944年受中共中央委託起草《關於軍隊政治工作問題的報告》。
body.en: After the Long March began in October 1934, Tan served as political commissar of the 1st Division and head of the organisation department of the political department of the 1st Army Corps. In June 1936 he entered the Red Army University and afterwards headed the organisation department and then the Rear Political Department. After the war with Japan broke out he became deputy director of the Central Military Commission General Political Department and director of the Eighth Route Army Rear Political Department; in 1943 he was transferred to the Shaan-Gan-Ning–Jin-Sui Joint Defence Army as deputy political commissar and political department director, and in 1944 was commissioned by the Party Centre to draft a report on political work in the army.

citations.quote: 1934年10月长征开始后，任红1师政治委员、红1军团政治部组织部部长
1936年6月入中国工农红军大学学习，毕业后任红军后方政治部组织部部长、政治部主任
抗日战争爆发后，任中央军委总政治部副主任兼八路军后方政治部主任
1943年调任陕甘宁晋绥联防军副政治委员兼政治部主任
1944年受中共中央委托，起草《关于军队政治工作问题的报告》

heading.en: Northeast China and the civil war

body.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭勝利後，譚政被抽調到東北，先後任東北民主聯軍和東北野戰軍政治部主任。遼瀋戰役中他深入前線各部隊開展戰時政治工作；平津戰役開始後號召廣大指戰員「打響進關第一炮」。1949年1月任天津市軍事管制委員會副主任，3月任第四野戰軍副政治委員兼政治部主任，參與指揮四野渡江戰役。
body.en: After victory in the war against Japan, Tan was transferred to the Northeast and served successively as political department director of the Northeast Democratic Allied Army and the Northeast Field Army. During the Liaoshen campaign he went to front-line units to carry out wartime political work, and once the Pingjin campaign began he urged officers and men to "fire the first shot into the Pass". In January 1949 he became deputy director of the Tianjin Military Control Commission, and in March deputy political commissar and political department director of the Fourth Field Army, helping direct its Yangtze River crossing campaign.

citations.quote: 抗日战争胜利后被抽调到东北，先后任东北民主联军和东北野战军政治部主任
辽沈战役中，深入前线各部队，大力开展战时政治工作
号召广大指战员“打响进关第一炮”
1949年1月任天津市军事管制委员会副主任
3月任第四野战军副政治委员兼政治部主任，参与指挥四野渡江战役

heading.zh-Hant: 建國後的軍隊政治工作
heading.en: Army political work after 1949

body.zh-Hant: 新中國建立後，譚政任第四野戰軍兼中南軍區第三政治委員、華南軍區政治委員等職，參與指揮解放海南島。1954年10月調任解放軍總政治部第一副主任，1956年12月任總政治部主任、國防部副部長。1960年9月在中央軍委擴大會議上受到錯誤批判，1979年3月獲正式平反，1988年11月6日在北京逝世。
body.en: After the People's Republic was founded Tan served as third political commissar of the Fourth Field Army and Central-South Military Region and as political commissar of the South China Military Region, helping direct the liberation of Hainan Island. In October 1954 he became first deputy director of the PLA General Political Department; in December 1956 he became its director and a vice-minister of national defence. He was wrongly criticised at the enlarged Central Military Commission meeting of September 1960, was formally rehabilitated in March 1979, and died in Beijing on 6 November 1988.

华南军区政治委员

heading.en: Early career and the Nanchang Uprising

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，賀龍1896年3月22日生於湖南桑植。1917年9月回鄉組織農民武裝，任湘西護法援鄂軍民軍第1路游擊司令。1926年7月率部加入國民革命軍，任第8軍第6師師長兼湘西鎮守使，8月改任第9軍第1師師長。1927年6月任第20軍軍長；7月到南昌後被周恩來代表中共前敵委員會委任為起義軍總指揮兼第20軍軍長，參與領導「八一」南昌起義，9月在江西瑞金加入中國共產黨。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, He Long was born on 22 March 1896 in Sangzhi, Hunan. In September 1917 he returned home to raise a peasant force and became commander of the 1st route guerrillas of the Western Hunan Hufa Yuan-E army. In July 1926 he joined the National Revolutionary Army as commander of the 6th Division of the 8th Army and Western Hunan garrison commander, and in August became commander of the 1st Division of the 9th Army. In June 1927 he became commander of the 20th Army; at Nanchang in July he was appointed by Zhou Enlai, representing the Party Front Committee, as commander-in-chief of the uprising army and of the 20th Army, helping lead the 1 August Nanchang Uprising, and in September at Ruijin, Jiangxi, he joined the Communist Party.

heading.zh-Hant: 紅2軍團、紅二方面軍與長征
heading.en: Red 2nd Army Corps, the Second Front Army and the Long March

body.zh-Hant: 1930年7月賀龍率部東進，在洪湖與紅6軍會合，任合編的紅2軍團總指揮；1931年3月紅2軍團改編為紅3軍，他任軍長。1934年10月紅3軍與紅6軍團會師後恢復紅2軍團番號，他任軍團長，並發起湘西攻勢，11月從桑植劉家坪出發長征。1936年紅2、紅6軍團及紅32軍合編為紅二方面軍，他任總指揮，10月在將台堡與紅一方面軍會師，11月指揮所部參加山城堡戰役。
body.en: In July 1930 He Long led his troops east, joined the Red 6th Army at Honghu, and became commander-in-chief of the merged 2nd Army Corps; in March 1931 the corps was reorganised as the Red 3rd Army with him as commander. In October 1934, after the 3rd Army met the 6th Army Corps, the 2nd Army Corps designation was restored with him as corps commander, and he launched the western Hunan offensive that month; in November he set out from Liujiaping, Sangzhi, on the Long March. In 1936 the 2nd and 6th Army Corps and the 32nd Army were merged into the Second Front Army with him as commander-in-chief; in October they joined the First Front Army at Jiangtaibao, and in November he directed the Shanchengbao campaign.

heading.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭：第120師與晉綏軍區
heading.en: The war against Japan: 120th Division and Jin-Sui

body.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭爆發後，賀龍任八路軍第120師師長，與政治委員關向應率部開赴晉西北抗日前線，在雁門關等地打擊日軍。1938年3月指揮所部殲日偽軍1500餘人，先後收復寧武、神池等7座縣城；1939年4月指揮齊會戰鬥。1940年8月指揮所部和山西新軍一部參加百團大戰，11月任晉西北軍區司令員。1942年起任晉綏軍區司令員、陝甘寧晉綏聯防軍司令員，並派359旅到南泥灣屯墾。
body.en: After the war with Japan broke out, He Long became commander of the Eighth Route Army's 120th Division and, with political commissar Guan Xiangying, led it to the northwest Shanxi front, striking the Japanese at Yanmen Pass and elsewhere. In March 1938 his forces killed or wounded over 1,500 Japanese and puppet troops and recovered seven county seats including Ningwu and Shenchi; in April 1939 he directed the Qihui battle. In August 1940 he directed his troops and part of the Shanxi New Army in the Hundred Regiments Offensive, and in November became commander of the Northwest Shanxi Military Region. From 1942 he commanded the Jin-Sui Military Region and the Shaan-Gan-Ning–Jin-Sui Joint Defence Army and sent the 359th Brigade to reclaim land at Nanniwan.

body.zh-Hant: 日本投降後，賀龍1946年7月指揮晉北戰役，殲國民黨軍閻錫山部8600餘人。1949年2月任西北軍區司令員，11月率第18兵團翻越秦嶺進入四川作戰，協同第二野戰軍發起成都戰役。1950年2月任西南軍區司令員，同年6月指揮進藏部隊解放昌都。1969年6月8日在糖尿病惡化的情況下被注射葡萄糖，9日因糖尿病酸中毒去世。
body.en: After Japan's surrender He Long directed the northern Shanxi campaign in July 1946, destroying over 8,600 troops of Yan Xishan's forces. In February 1949 he became commander of the Northwest Military Region, and in November led the 18th Army Group over the Qinling Mountains into Sichuan, joining the Second Field Army in launching the Chengdu campaign. In February 1950 he became commander of the Southwest Military Region, and in June that year directed the troops advancing into Tibet to liberate Chamdo. On 8 June 1969 he was given a glucose injection while his diabetes was worsening, and died of diabetic acidosis on the 9th.

heading.en: Early life, Whampoa and the Central Special Section

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，陳賡1903年2月27日生於湖南湘鄉。1923年12月考入廣州陸軍講武學校，1924年5月轉入黃埔軍校第一期，畢業後留校任入伍生連長、副隊長，參加兩次東征，在第二次東征中將身陷險境的蔣介石背到安全地帶。1927年7月隨周恩來赴江西參加南昌起義，8月下旬在會昌戰鬥中左腿負重傷；1928年4月傷癒後分配到中共中央特科從事情報搜集和反間諜工作。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Chen Geng was born on 27 February 1903 in Xiangxiang, Hunan. In December 1923 he entered the Guangzhou Army Lecture School and in May 1924 moved to the first class of Whampoa Academy; after graduating he stayed on as a cadet company commander and deputy detachment leader and took part in both Eastern Expeditions, carrying Chiang Kai-shek to safety in the second. In July 1927 he went with Zhou Enlai to Jiangxi for the Nanchang Uprising and was badly wounded in the left leg in the Huichang fighting in late August; after recovering in April 1928 he was assigned to the CCP Central Special Section, working on intelligence and counter-espionage.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年11月陳賡任紅四方面軍第4軍第12師師長，率部參加黃安、商潢、潢光等戰役。1933年3月因叛徒出賣被捕，獲營救後前往中央蘇區，擔任彭楊步兵學校校長。1934年10月隨軍長征，任軍委幹部團團長；1935年9月任陝甘支隊第13大隊大隊長，到陝北後調任紅1軍團第1師師長，參加直羅鎮、東征、西征和山城堡戰役。
body.en: In November 1931 Chen Geng became commander of the 12th Division of the 4th Army, Red Fourth Front Army, and fought in the Huang'an, Shanghuang and Huangguang campaigns. He was arrested in March 1933 after a betrayal; once rescued he went to the Central Soviet Area and became head of the Peng-Yang Infantry School. He joined the Long March in October 1934 as commander of the Cadre Regiment of the Military Commission, in September 1935 became a detachment commander in the Shaan-Gan Detachment, and after reaching northern Shaanxi commanded the 1st Division of the 1st Army Corps, taking part in the Zhiluozhen, Eastern Expedition, Western Expedition and Shanchengbao campaigns.

heading.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭：第386旅與太岳軍區
heading.en: The war against Japan: 386th Brigade and Taiyue

body.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭爆發後，陳賡任八路軍第129師386旅旅長，在正太鐵路一線先後取得長生口、七亘村、廣陽等戰鬥的勝利。1938年3月設伏神頭嶺，斃傷日軍1500餘人；4月反擊長樂村，殲敵2200餘人。1940年春任新成立的太岳軍區司令員，8月至12月率部參加百團大戰並指揮榆遼戰役；1942年10月起組織指揮歷時兩年半的沁源圍困戰。
body.en: After the war with Japan broke out, Chen Geng became commander of the 386th Brigade of the Eighth Route Army's 129th Division and won the Changshengkou, Qigengcun and Guangyang engagements along the Zhengtai railway. In March 1938 he set an ambush at Shentouling, killing or wounding over 1,500 Japanese; in April he counter-attacked at Changlecun, destroying over 2,200. In spring 1940 he became commander of the newly formed Taiyue Military Region, took part in the Hundred Regiments Offensive from August to December and directed the Yushe–Liaoxian campaign; from October 1942 he organised and directed the two-and-a-half-year siege of Qinyuan.

body.zh-Hant: 1947年8月陳賡奉命指揮陳謝集團南渡黃河、挺進豫西；1948年11月參加淮海戰役，在南平集阻擊黃維兵團。1949年2月任第二野戰軍第4兵團司令員兼政治委員，4月參加渡江戰役，並參與指揮廣東、廣西戰役。1950年1月指揮滇南戰役；1951年6月任志願軍副司令員兼第3兵團司令員、政治委員。1952年6月奉命籌建哈爾濱軍事工程學院，1961年3月16日在上海逝世。
body.en: In August 1947 Chen Geng was ordered to command the Chen–Xie group across the Yellow River into western Henan; in November 1948 he joined the Huaihai campaign, blocking Huang Wei's army group at Nanpingji. In February 1949 he became commander and political commissar of the 4th Army Group of the Second Field Army, took part in the Yangtze crossing in April and helped direct the Guangdong and Guangxi campaigns. In January 1950 he directed the southern Yunnan campaign; in June 1951 he became deputy commander of the Chinese People's Volunteers and commander and political commissar of its 3rd Army Group. In June 1952 he was ordered to set up the Harbin Military Engineering Institute, and he died in Shanghai on 16 March 1961.

heading.en: Early life and the Southern Hunan Uprising

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，黃克誠1902年10月1日生於湖南永興下青村的農民家庭，1925年加入中國共產黨。1926年初入廣州中央政治講習班，結業後參加北伐戰爭，在國民革命軍第8軍任營、團政治指導員。1928年初參加湘南起義，任永興紅色警衛團黨代表兼參謀長，後隨朱德、陳毅上井岡山，任工農革命軍第4軍第12師第35團團長；1930年初奉派到彭德懷領導的紅5軍。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Huang Kecheng was born on 1 October 1902 into a peasant family in Yongxing, Hunan, and joined the Communist Party in 1925. In early 1926 he entered the Central Political Training Class in Guangzhou and then took part in the Northern Expedition as a battalion and regimental political instructor in the National Revolutionary Army's 8th Army. In early 1928 he joined the Southern Hunan Uprising as Party representative and chief of staff of the Yongxing Red Guard Regiment, then followed Zhu De and Chen Yi to the Jinggang Mountains as commander of the 35th Regiment, 12th Division, 4th Army; in early 1930 he was sent to Peng Dehuai's Red 5th Army.

heading.en: The Red 3rd Army Corps and the Long March

body.zh-Hant: 1931年起，黃克誠任紅3軍團第4師政治部主任、第3師和第1師政治委員。1934年10月他率部作為前衛開始長征，在湘江南岸頑強抗擊數倍敵人的輪番進攻，掩護中共中央和軍委縱隊渡江。1935年2月紅3軍團撤銷師編制後改任第10團政治委員，參加四渡赤水和遵義戰役。到陝北後任紅1軍團第4師政治委員、紅軍總政治部組織部部長，參加東征、西征和山城堡戰役。
body.en: From 1931 Huang Kecheng served as director of the political department of the 4th Division of the Red 3rd Army Corps and as political commissar of its 3rd and 1st Divisions. In October 1934 he led his troops as vanguard on the Long March and on the south bank of the Xiang River resisted repeated assaults by far larger forces to cover the Party Centre column's crossing. In February 1935, after the corps abolished its divisions, he became political commissar of the 10th Regiment and took part in the Four Crossings of the Chishui and the Zunyi campaign. In northern Shaanxi he became political commissar of the 4th Division of the 1st Army Corps and head of the organisation department of the General Political Department, and fought in the Eastern and Western Expeditions and at Shanchengbao.

heading.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭：344旅至新四軍第3師
heading.en: The war against Japan: 344th Brigade to the New Fourth Army 3rd Division

body.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭爆發時，黃克誠任八路軍總政治部組織部部長，不久改任第115師344旅政治委員，同旅長徐海東開展敵後游擊戰爭。1940年2月起任八路軍第2縱隊政治委員、冀魯豫軍區司令員兼政治委員；8月奉命轉赴皖東北，整編為八路軍第5縱隊，任司令員兼政治委員。1941年1月皖南事變後所部改編為新四軍第3師，他任師長兼政治委員，並於1944年4月開始局部反攻。
body.en: When the war with Japan broke out Huang Kecheng was head of the organisation department of the Eighth Route Army General Political Department; he soon became political commissar of the 344th Brigade, 115th Division, and with commander Xu Haidong waged guerrilla war behind enemy lines. From February 1940 he was political commissar of the 2nd Column and commander and political commissar of the Hebei-Shandong-Henan Military Region; in August he was ordered to northeastern Anhui, where he merged several units into the 5th Column as its commander and political commissar. After the New Fourth Army Incident of January 1941 his force became the New Fourth Army's 3rd Division, with him as commander and political commissar, and in April 1944 began a local counter-offensive.

heading.en: The march to Northeast China and the northeastern campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1945年9月23日中央軍委命黃克誠率新四軍第3師主力3萬餘人進軍東北，他9月28日率部出發，11月25日進抵遼寧錦州附近。1946年1月起任西滿軍區副政治委員、司令員；1948年4月任中共冀察熱遼分局書記兼冀察熱遼軍區政治委員、東北野戰軍第2兵團政治委員；1949年1月任天津市軍管會主任、中共天津市委書記。
body.en: On 23 September 1945 the Central Military Commission ordered Huang Kecheng to lead more than 30,000 troops of the New Fourth Army's 3rd Division into Northeast China; he set out on 28 September and reached the vicinity of Jinzhou, Liaoning, on 25 November. From January 1946 he was deputy political commissar and then commander of the West Manchuria Military Region; in April 1948 he became secretary of the Hebei-Rehe-Liaoning Sub-bureau, political commissar of its military region and political commissar of the Northeast Field Army's 2nd Army Group; in January 1949 he became director of the Tianjin Military Control Commission and Tianjin Party secretary.

body.zh-Hant: 1952年11月黃克誠調任解放軍副總參謀長兼總後勤部部長、政治委員，1958年10月任總參謀長。1959年在廬山會議上因直言批評「大躍進」、「人民公社」運動中的「左」傾錯誤，同彭德懷等人一起被定為「反黨集團」，被撤銷一切職務。1978年12月當選中央紀律檢查委員會常務書記，1986年12月28日在北京病逝。
body.en: In November 1952 Huang Kecheng became deputy chief of the General Staff and head and political commissar of the General Logistics Department, and in October 1958 Chief of the General Staff. At the 1959 Lushan meeting, for frankly criticising "leftist" errors in the Great Leap Forward and people's commune movements, he was labelled part of an "anti-Party clique" together with Peng Dehuai and others and stripped of all posts. In December 1978 he was elected standing secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and he died in Beijing on 28 December 1986.

heading.en: Early life and underground Party work

body.zh-Hant: 據泰安徂徠山抗日武裝起義紀念館的生平簡介，黎玉1906年5月12日生於山西崞縣，1926年9月經劉保粹、馮漢瑛介紹加入中國共產黨。1930年10月至1931年初任中共北平市委市政工作委員會書記、職工部長；1933年春任中共唐山市委書記，1934年初領導開灤五礦總同盟三萬餘人的反帝大罷工。
body.en: According to the biography on the website of the Culai Mountain Anti-Japanese Armed Uprising Memorial Hall, Li Yu was born on 12 May 1906 in Guo County, Shanxi, and joined the Communist Party in September 1926 on the introduction of Liu Baocui and Feng Hanying. From October 1930 to early 1931 he was secretary of the municipal-work committee and head of the labour department of the CCP Beiping Municipal Committee; in spring 1933 he became secretary of the CCP Tangshan Municipal Committee, and in early 1934 led the anti-imperialist general strike of more than 30,000 workers of the Kailuan five mines.

黎玉于这年9月经刘保粹、冯汉瑛介绍加入中国共产党

heading.zh-Hant: 重建山東省委與徂徠山起義
heading.en: Rebuilding the Shandong committee and the Culai Mountain uprising

body.zh-Hant: 1936年5月1日，黎玉在濟南主持召開重建中共山東省委的會議並任書記。1938年1月1日徂徠山武裝起義舉行誓師大會，黎玉代表省委宣布成立八路軍山東人民抗日游擊隊第四支隊，洪濤任司令員，黎玉兼任政委；1月26日第四支隊在寺嶺伏擊日軍，2月18日在新泰四槐樹村附近以地雷炸毀日軍運輸車隊。2月下旬省委決定由黎玉去延安匯報，他於4月初到達延安。
body.en: On 1 May 1936 Li Yu presided in Jinan over the meeting that rebuilt the CCP Shandong Provincial Committee and became its secretary. On 1 January 1938 the Culai Mountain uprising held its oath-taking rally, at which Li announced on behalf of the provincial committee the founding of the Eighth Route Army Shandong People's Anti-Japanese Guerrilla Force, 4th Detachment, with Hong Tao as commander and Li concurrently political commissar. On 26 January the 4th Detachment ambushed Japanese troops at Siling, and on 18 February it blew up a Japanese transport convoy with landmines near Sihuaishu village in Xintai. In late February the committee decided Li should report to Yan'an, and he arrived in early April.

citations.quote: 1936年5月1日，在济南四里山北边的一块长满松柏的坟地里，黎玉主持召开了重建中共山东省委的会议
黎玉任书记，林浩任宣传部长，赵健民任组织部长
1938年1月1日，徂徕山武装起义在徂徕山南大寺前举行誓师大会
宣布成立“八路军山东人民抗日游击队第四支队”，洪涛任司令员，黎玉兼任政委
1月26日，四支队在良庄以东的寺岭伏击了经大汶口开向新泰的日军
2月18日，又在新泰境内的四槐树村附近公路上，以伏击手段用地雷炸毁了日军的运输车队
1938年2月下旬，省委在新泰刘杜镇召开扩大会议
决定由黎玉去延安向党中央汇报山东抗日斗争情况
于4月初顺利到达延安

heading.en: Shandong Column and Shandong Military Region

body.zh-Hant: 1938年12月27日，八路軍山東縱隊在沂水縣王莊宣布成立，張經武任指揮，黎玉任政治委員。同月中共中央決定設立中共中央山東分局，郭洪濤、張經武、黎玉為委員。1940年黎玉任山東戰時工作執行委員會主任；1943年任山東軍區副政委、山東戰時行政委員會主任、中共山東分局副書記。1945年12月山東分局改組為中共華東局，他任副書記。
body.en: On 27 December 1938 the Eighth Route Army Shandong Column was proclaimed at Wangzhuang, Yishui County, with Zhang Jingwu as commander and Li Yu as political commissar. That month the Party Centre decided to set up the CCP Central Committee Shandong Sub-bureau, with Guo Hongtao, Zhang Jingwu and Li Yu as members. In 1940 Li became director of the Shandong Wartime Work Executive Committee; in 1943 he became deputy political commissar of the Shandong Military Region, director of the Shandong Wartime Administrative Committee and deputy secretary of the Shandong Sub-bureau. In December 1945 the Sub-bureau was reorganised as the CCP East China Bureau, with him as deputy secretary.

heading.en: After 1949

body.zh-Hant: 中華人民共和國成立後，黎玉1954年起任第一機械工業部副部長，1959年起任農業機械部常務副部長、黨組副書記，1978年起任機械工業部顧問，1986年5月30日病逝於北京。
body.en: After the founding of the People's Republic Li Yu served from 1954 as vice-minister of the First Ministry of Machine-Building, from 1959 as first executive vice-minister and deputy Party secretary of the Ministry of Agricultural Machinery, and from 1978 as adviser to the Ministry of Machine-Building; he died in Beijing on 30 May 1986.
